spans.title: The Night Errand
spans.blurb: Sent for water after dark, a small girl stands frozen between the terrors of the night forest and the woman waiting at home.

spans.title: The Convict at the Door
spans.blurb: Turned away from every inn and even a dog's kennel, a weary stranger announces exactly what he is at a quiet fireside, and waits to be cast out.

books.pairNote: Two unrelated scenes, a child in the forest and a stranger at a fireside; nothing shared.

spans.title: Fair Warning
spans.blurb: Before a young visitor meets the notorious professor, the great man's wife takes him aside with urgent instructions on surviving the encounter.

spans.title: An Audience with the Professor
spans.blurb: A journalist bluffs his way into a volcanic scientist's study armed with borrowed jargon, hoping the great man will not notice.

books.pairNote: The short is the scene immediately before the story begins; no shared text, and each lands its own joke.

spans.title: The Two Wills
spans.blurb: At three in the morning a dying miser, all his faculties sharp, orders his young night-nurse to open the iron chest and burn one of his two wills.
spans.spoilerNote: Gives away the two-wills deathbed night behind the book's inheritance surprise, though not which will stands.

spans.title: Forty Yards of Lion
spans.blurb: Alone on foot with a rifle, a traveller faces his first charging lion and coolly reasons where the single stopping bullet must go.

spans.title: The Curse in the Armoury
spans.blurb: Amid the sack of a palace, an officer follows screams to a torchlit room, a bloodied dagger, and a dying man's last words.

spans.title: The Shivering Sand
spans.blurb: An old house-steward tries to coax a sad young housemaid away from the quicksand that draws her, until an unexpected arrival changes her face.

books.pairNote: A battlefield prologue and a quiet seaside scene told by a different narrator; nothing shared.

spans.title: The Matter of the Wedding-Cake
spans.blurb: A kindly invalid who distrusts all rich food wages a polite one-man campaign against the neighbourhood's wedding-cake.

spans.title: I Would Not Influence You
spans.blurb: A farmer's heartfelt proposal arrives by letter, and a young woman's clever friend insists, repeatedly, that the decision must be entirely her own.

books.pairNote: A domestic comic miniature and a drawing-room persuasion scene; different characters at the centre, nothing shared.

spans.title: First Swim by Moonlight
spans.blurb: After a summer of failed lessons, a woman suddenly finds her stroke one night and swims out alone toward the moonlit horizon.

spans.title: The Hammock
spans.blurb: Past midnight, a wife stays out in the hammock; her husband commands, coaxes, and finally sits smoking beside a will he cannot move.

books.pairNote: Two scenes from the same summer night, the swim and then the hammock; sequential with no shared text, and each carries its own charge.

spans.title: The Gentleman in the Rain
spans.blurb: A twisted ankle on a wet hillside brings a handsome stranger who carries the injured girl home and leaves the whole household wondering.

spans.title: The Pearl Diver and the Shark
spans.blurb: From the shadow of a rock, undersea watchers observe a poor diver work his oyster bed, until a huge shape glides over him.

spans.title: The Doctor's Menagerie
spans.blurb: In a dim vault, a captor fondles his marmoset and lovingly catalogues the scorpions, pythons, and spiders he keeps for his enemies.
